# nonValidSheetName

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is **not** a sheet name.</link-summary>

<web-summary>nonValidSheetName() — Checks whether a value is **not** a sheet name. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function nonValidSheetName(value: unknown): boolean;
```

`nonValidSheetName(value)` is the same test as `!isValidSheetName(value)`, written so that a guard clause reads as a sentence rather than as a negation.

What Google Sheets accepts: at most 100 characters, not blank, none of `\ / ? * [ ]`, and not the reserved name `history` in any case.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is not a sheet name; otherwise `false`.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
nonValidSheetName("history"); // => true
nonValidSheetName("Data/2026"); // => true
nonValidSheetName(""); // => true
nonValidSheetName("Data"); // => false
nonValidSheetName("Report 2026"); // => false
```
